SELECT
  $1::text AS fingerprint,
  $2::text AS payload_json,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM clickup_webhook_seen
    WHERE fingerprint = $1
  ) AS already_seen;

WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO clickup_webhook_seen (fingerprint)
  SELECT $1
  WHERE $1 IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING fingerprint, 'inserted' AS action
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT fingerprint FROM upsert),
    $1
  ) AS fingerprint,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT action FROM upsert),
    'existing'
  ) AS action;

WITH subtask_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as count
  FROM clickup_tasks 
  WHERE parent_task_id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
),
deleted_task AS (
  DELETE FROM clickup_tasks 
  WHERE task_id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
  RETURNING task_id, task_name
)
SELECT 
  d.task_id,
  d.task_name,
  COALESCE(sc.count, 0) as subtasks_deleted,
  CASE 
    WHEN d.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DELETED'
    ELSE 'NOT FOUND'
  END as result
FROM deleted_task d
CROSS JOIN subtask_count sc;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO clickup_tasks (task_id, task_name)
  VALUES ($1, 'Unknown Task')
  ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING task_id
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT task_id FROM ins), $1) AS task_id;

WITH picked_rate AS (
    -- Find the effective rate for this assignee on entry date
    SELECT 
        r.rate_id,
        r.currency,
        r.hourly_rate_cents
    FROM assignee_rates r
    WHERE r.assignee_id = $3  -- user_id
      AND daterange(
            date_trunc('day', $6::timestamptz)::date,  -- start_time
            date_trunc('day', $6::timestamptz)::date + 1,
            '[]'
          ) && r.valid_daterange
    ORDER BY r.valid_from DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
calc AS (
    -- Calculate cost based on rate and hours
    SELECT
        COALESCE(pr.rate_id, NULL) AS rate_id,
        COALESCE(pr.currency, 'AUD') AS currency,
        COALESCE(pr.hourly_rate_cents, 0) AS hourly_rate_cents,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(pr.hourly_rate_cents, 0) * $8::numeric  -- ✅ FIXED: Cast to numeric
        )::bigint AS cost_cents
    FROM picked_rate pr
)
INSERT INTO clickup_time_entries (
    time_entry_id,
    task_id,
    user_id,
    user_name,
    user_email,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    duration_hours,
    billable,
    description,
    -- New cost fields
    rate_id,
    currency,
    hourly_rate_cents,
    cost_cents
)
VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::numeric, $9, $10,  -- ✅ FIXED: Cast $8 here too
    (SELECT rate_id FROM calc),
    (SELECT currency FROM calc),
    (SELECT hourly_rate_cents FROM calc),
    (SELECT cost_cents FROM calc)
)
ON CONFLICT (time_entry_id) DO UPDATE SET
    user_name = EXCLUDED.user_name,
    user_email = EXCLUDED.user_email,
    start_time = EXCLUDED.start_time,
    end_time = EXCLUDED.end_time,
    duration_hours = EXCLUDED.duration_hours,
    billable = EXCLUDED.billable,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    -- Update cost fields
    rate_id = EXCLUDED.rate_id,
    currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
    hourly_rate_cents = EXCLUDED.hourly_rate_cents,
    cost_cents = EXCLUDED.cost_cents,
    synced_at = NOW()
RETURNING 
    time_entry_id,
    task_id,
    user_name,
    duration_hours,
    cost_cents,
    currency,
    rate_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN rate_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_RATE_FOUND'
        ELSE 'COST_CALCULATED'
    END AS status;
